The insights form part of a British Academy-funded collaboration with Loughborough University, using linked data to explore the factors associated with children’s mental health. The analysis is for England only, using Hospital Episode Statistics, Emergency Care Dataset data, National Pupil Database, and NHS Talking Therapies (for adults), linked to Census 2021.
